reason: The 10-K filing for FactSet Research Systems Inc. (fiscal year ended August 31, 2025) does not disclose a Total Addressable Market (TAM) figure. The company describes its business model, client base (approximately 9,000 clients with over 237,000 investment professionals), revenue segments (Americas 65%, EMEA 25%, Asia Pacific 10%), and organic ASV retention metrics (greater than 95%), but does not provide any company-disclosed TAM estimate for its financial data and analytics platform market. No investor day materials, earnings calls, or other filings referenced in this document contain TAM disclosures.
